rules.rule: When designing a class interface or game logic, ensure that type annotations on class attributes exactly match their constructor parameter types to maintain static analysis consistency, and define reward conventions (Win/Draw/Loss) explicitly for the acting agent to preserve signal integrity in reinforcement learning contexts.

When designing an experiment that interacts with external harnesses or requires symmetric evaluation of opposing roles, explicitly verify data format compatibility (e.g., ensuring required CSV columns like 'method' are present) and interface symmetry requirements (e.g., whether a single policy can handle both player sides without explicit state normalization or role-switching logic), because assuming implicit support for these structural details leads to inexecutable plans.
